title: SessionRevokedEvent
description: Emitted when an authentication session is explicitly revoked (ADR-0016 §27 'Authentication Session Lifecycle' -- CREATED/ACTIVE -> REVOKED is a distinct outcome from ordinary EXPIRED/TERMINATED endings, and §31 'Session Revocation Levels' -- current session, selected sessions, or all sessions). session_id references contracts/identity/v1/session.schema.json's id. This is the event envelope's `data` payload — see asyncapi.yaml for how it composes with contracts/events/v1/envelope.schema.json.

actor.description: Who performed the action (system or human ID).
